answer.summary: Loads the customer master file into an in-memory array for fast lookup. It constructs a full name field by concatenating first and last names with a single space. Provides a search entry point to find a customer index by their number.
inputs: CUSTFILE (KDS_SATZ record: KDS_NR, KDS_VORN, KDS_NACHN, KDS_FICO)

rules.text: Initializes the customer count to 0 before loading.
Sets an end-of-file flag when the file read reaches the end.
Continues reading records until the end-of-file flag is set.
Checks if the in-memory array is full before adding a new record; if full, calls error procedure KBU00011 with severity 16 and message 'KUNDENTABELLE VOLL'.
Increments the customer count if the array is not full.
Stores the customer number from the file record into the array.
Constructs the full name by trimming the first name, adding a single space, and appending the trimmed last name.
Stores the FICO score (bonitaet) from the file record into the array.
Searches the in-memory array for a matching customer number; returns the 1-based index if found, or 0 if not found.
